name: 华为JS编程规则集
nameEn: Huawei Js Coding Standard Rule Set
comments: 确保代码遵从华为编码规范
commentsEn: Rule suite for Huawei Coding Standard
creator: system

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.04 Avoid negative boolean variable names
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.04 避免使用否定的布尔变量名

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.02 Use === or !== instead of == or != to compare the equivalence
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.02 判断相等时应使用 === 和 !== ，而不是 == 和 !=

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.01 When comparing expressions, follow the principle that the left side tends to change and the right side tends to remain unchanged
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.01 表达式的比较，应该遵循左侧倾向于变化、右侧倾向于不变的原则

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.03 Variables should be named in LowerCamelCase style
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.03 变量应采用小驼峰风格命名

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.03 Do not use return, break, continue or throw exception to abruptly terminate the finally block
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.03 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.02 Name functions in lower camel case
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.02 函数应采用小驼峰风格命名

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.02 Use Error objects as Promise rejection reasons
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.02 应使用 Error 对象作为 Promise 拒绝的原因

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.01 Name constructors and classes in upper camel case
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.01 构造器函数、类应采用大驼峰风格命名

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.01 Use exceptions properly
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.01 合理使用异常

ruleInfos.name: G.MOD.01 The variable to be exported must be of the immutable type
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MOD.01 需要导出的变量必须是不可变的类型

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.07 Avoid including too many conditions in a condition/loop control statement
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.07 避免在条件/循环控制语句中包含过多的条件

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.12 Use arrow functions instead of anonymous functions to replace the method of holding the this reference
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.12 用到匿名函数时优先使用箭头函数，替代保存this引用的方式

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.09 Do not remove or add elements during array traversal
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.09 不要在数组遍历中对其进行元素的 remove/add 操作

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.06 Do not perform an assignment in a controlling conditional expression
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.06 不要在控制性条件表达式中执行赋值操作

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.11 Prefer destructuring from function parameters
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.11 建议使用参数的解构

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.08 Prefer using methods of Array object for array traversal
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.08 数组遍历优先使用 Array 对象方法

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.05 Avoid using logical operators to replace control statements
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.05 避免用逻辑运算符代替控制语句

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.10 Use rest parameters instead of arguments
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.10 不要使用 arguments，可以选择 rest 语法替代

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.07 Do not define or use non-numeric properties on arrays(except length)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.07 不要在数组上定义或使用非数字属性（length 除外）

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.09 Do not reassign values to function parameters
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.09 不要给函数的入参重新赋值

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.06  Avoid multiline strings
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.06 不应使用字符串的行连续符号

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.04 An else branch should be added at the end of if statement containing else if branch
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.04 含else if分支的条件判断应在最后加一个else分支

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.08 Do not create functions dynamically
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.08 不要动态创建函数

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.05  Prefer template literals instead of string concatenation
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.05 使用模板字符串（`）实现字符串拼接

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.03 Braces {} cannot be omitted when lexical declarations are required in case statements
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.03 case 语句中需要词法声明时, 大括号{}不能省略

ruleInfos.name: G.WST.02 Use non-persistent session cookies or sessionStorage instead of localStorage if data only needs to be stored temporarily on the client.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.WST.02 如果数据仅需要临时存储在客户端，使用非持久性会话cookie或者sessionStorage而不是localStorage

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.07 Use consistent return clauses
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.07 建议使用一致的 return 语句

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.04 Use single quotes to define strings
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.04 建议字符串使用单引号

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.02 A break statement should be placed in every case branch with content in the switch statement
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.02 在 switch 语句的每一个有内容的 case 中都应放置一条 break 语句

ruleInfos.name: G.WST.01 Do not store any sensitive data in localStorage and sessionStorage
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.WST.01 禁止在 localStorage和sessionStorage中存储敏感数据

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.03  Do not directly use == or === to determine the equivalence of floating point data
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.03 浮点型数据判断相等不要直接使用== 或===

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.01 A switch statement must have a default branch
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.01 每个 switch 语句都应包含一个 default 分支

ruleInfos.name: G.WSQ.01 Do not store any sensitive data in Web SQL database and Indexed database
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.WSQ.01 禁止在 Web SQL database和Indexed database数据库中存储敏感数据

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.06 Enforce default parameters to be last
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.06 始终将默认参数放在最后

ruleInfos.name: G.CORS.01 Origins should be strictly verified during cross-origin communications with the postMessage method
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CORS.01 使用postMessage方法实现跨域时，应严格校验Origin

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.07  Avoid variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.07 避免当前作用域中的变量覆盖更外层作用域的变量

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.05 The number of function arguments should be no more than 5
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.05 函数的参数个数不建议超过 5 个

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.02 Must calling to isNaN() when checking for NaN
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.02 判断变量是否为NaN时必须使用 isNaN() 方法

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.04 File header comments should contain the copyright notice
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.04 文件头注释包含版权说明

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.06 Use literal-style declarations
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.06 使用字面量风格的声明

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.03 The maximum nesting depth of a block statement should not exceed 4 layers
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.03 块语句的最大可嵌套深度不要超过 4 层

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.04 Callback functions cannot be nested more than 4 layers
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.04 回调函数嵌套的层数不超过 4 层

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.01 Do not omit 0s before and after floating point decimals.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.01 禁止省略浮点数小数点前后的 0

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.03 No TODO/FIXME comments should be contained in the code delivered to customers
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.03 正式交付给客户的代码不应包含 TODO/FIXME 注释

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.05 Avoid initializing variables to undefined
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.05 不要使用 undefined 初始化变量

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.02 Cyclomatic Complexity should not exceed 20
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.02 圈复杂度不超过 20

ruleInfos.name: G.SCO.01 Do not declare variables or functions in the global scope
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SCO.01 避免在全局作用域下声明变量和函数

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.02 There should be a space between the comment character and the comment content
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.02 注释符和注释内容之间留有一个空格

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.04 Do not use chained assignment expressions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.04 禁止连续赋值

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.01 The length of the function should not be too long
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.01 函数长度不宜过长

ruleInfos.name: G.PRJ.03 Control the length of the file, preferably no more than 2000 lines
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRJ.03 控制文件的长度，最好不要超过 2000 行

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.01 Comments should be positioned above or beside code
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.01 代码注释置于对应代码的上方或右边

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.03 Declare one variable in each line
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.03 每个语句只声明一个变量

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.12 Statements should end with semicolons
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.12 每句代码后加分号

ruleInfos.name: G.PRJ.01 Source files (including comments) should be encoded in UTF-8 format
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRJ.01 源文件编码格式（包括注释）应该是 UTF-8

ruleInfos.name: G.AOD.05 Do not use debugger
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.AOD.05 禁止使用 debugger

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.01 Use const or let instead of var to declare variables
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.01 声明变量时要求使用 const 或 let 而不是 var（ECMAScript 6）

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.11 Use trailing commas
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.11 使用拖尾逗号

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.05 Do not include public network addresses in code
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.05 禁止代码中包含公网地址

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.15 Use Number() to convert other types to numbers, and explicitly check whether the return value is NaN.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.15 其它类型转化为数字使用Number()，并且应显式检查返回值是否为NaN

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.10 The opening brace should be palced at the end of a line
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.10 大括号 { 和语句在同一行

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.04 Delete developers' personal information from official code and comments
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.04 正式发布的代码及注释内容不应包含开发者个人信息

ruleInfos.name: G.AOD.04 Do not use alert
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.AOD.04 禁止使用 alert

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.03 不用的代码段直接删除，不要注释掉

ruleInfos.name: G.AOD.03 Avoid using console
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.AOD.03 尽量避免使用console

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.14  Use explicit type conversions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.14 使用显式的类型转换

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.09 Braces should be used in the body of if/for/do/while statements
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.09 建议 if、for、do、while 等语句的执行体加大括号 {}

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.01 Use cryptographically secure random numbers in security scenarios
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.01 安全场景下必须使用密码学意义上的安全随机数

ruleInfos.name: G.AOD.02 Do not use implied eval()
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.AOD.02 禁止使用隐式的 eval()

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.11 Copy an array using the expansion syntax (...)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.11 使用展开语法 … 或concat复制数组

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.08 Use spaces to highlight keywords and important information
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.08 用空格突出关键字和重要信息

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.07 Do not modify Prototypes of builtin objects or add mothods to Prototypes
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.07 不要修改内置对象的原型，或向原型添加方法

ruleInfos.name: G.AOD.01 Do not use eval()
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.AOD.01 禁止使用 eval()

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.10 Prefer using destructuring from array
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.10 建议使用数组解构

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.07 Use blank lines properly
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.07 合理安排空行

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.06 Place else/catch on the same line as the closing parentheses of the if/try code block.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.06 把 else/catch 放在 if/try 代码块关闭括号的同一行

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.06 Constrained use for-in
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.06 需要约束 for-in

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.05 Methods can be invoked for a maximum of 4 at a line when object methods are invoked in chain mode. Otherwise, a line wrapping is required.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.05 链式调用对象方法时，一行最多调用 4 次，否则需要换行

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.05 Do not call hasOwnProperty, isPrototypeOf, propertyIsEnumerable methods directly on object instances
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.05 禁止在对象实例上直接使用 hasOwnProperty、isPrototypeOf、propertyIsEnumerable方法

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.04 Line wraps are required if there are more than 4 literal properties in an object
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.04 象字面量属性超过 4 个, 需要都换行

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.04 Preferentially use dots to access object properties, and [] to access calculated properties only
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.04 优先使用点号来访问对象的属性，只有计算属性使用 []

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.03 Operators should be placed at the end of lines during line wrapping
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.03 换行时将操作符留在行末

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.03 Use of the shorthand syntax of property and function in object literal
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.03 推荐在对象字面量中使用方法简写和属性简写

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.02 Each line should not be too long
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.02 行宽不宜过长

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.02 Object literal property names should be defined using literals
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.02 对象字面量的属性名称使用标识符

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.01 Use spaces to indent
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.01 使用空格进行缩进

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.01 Use parentheses when invoking a constructor with new keyword
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.01 通过 new 调用构造函数时，应始终使用圆括号

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.06 Prefer using named capture group in regular expression
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.06 建议在正则表达式中使用命名捕获组

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.06 Do not expose unnecessary information on UIs or in logs
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.06 禁止在用户界面、日志中暴露不必要信息

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.05 The number of repeated whitespace characters should be explicitly indicated in regular expression literals
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.05 正则表达式字面量中，应显式指出重复的空白字符个数

ruleInfos.name: G.NOD.04 Perform security checks before file decompression
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NOD.04 解压文件必须进行安全检查

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.07 Follow a consistent file naming style and the file extension should be lower case
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.07 使用统一的文件命名风格，文件扩展名应小写

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.04 Use parentheses to clarify the precedence of operations when different operators are mixed
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.04 在混合使用不同的操作符时，采用括号明确运算的优先级

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.05 Do not use reserved words as variable names. Synonyms of reserved words are acceptable
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.05 不要用保留字做为变量名，可使用保留字的同义词

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.03 Avoid nested ternary expressions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.03 禁止使用嵌套的三元表达式
